newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea files complaint with WTO against the U.S.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea files complaint with WTO against the U.S.

text.p: South Korea's trade ministry said on Thursday that it has filed a complaint with the World Trade Organisation (WTO) against the United States for imposing unfair antidumping charges on Korean color television sets, according to newspaper reports.

The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy said the complaint was filed on Thursday against a U.S. investigation into reports that South Korea has sold color televisions made in South Korea and shipped into the U.S. via Mexico, according to the local newspaper Chosun Ilbo.
Another local daily, the Korean Herald, said the complaint was directed at U.S. antidumping duties imposed on color television sets made by Samsung Electronics Co Ltd.
Ministry officials could not be reached for comment.
